$comment: Reconciliation manifest for the local CI gate. Read by packages/scripts-ts/src/check-ci-drift.ts.
One entry per step in .github/workflows, keyed by '<workflow>::<job>::<step name>'.
hash   - content hash of the step (run/uses + with + env + if) when it was last
reconciled. The guard recomputes it; a mismatch fails the gate.
mirror - the local command asserted to cover this step, or null when exempt.
reason - why the mirror covers it, or why it cannot run locally. Required.
IMPORTANT: `mirror` is a HUMAN ASSERTION, not something the guard verifies. The
guard's job is to make sure that assertion is re-made whenever the CI step changes,
so the local gate cannot drift out of sync in silence. When a hash mismatch sends
you here, actually re-read the workflow step before bumping the hash.

api-tests.yml::changes::Checkout classif.reason: GitHub-only: checks out the classifier script (packages/scripts-ts/src/ci-changed-paths.ts) from the pull request's base commit into base-ref/ rather than its own merge commit. This pins the classifier's SOURCE so an accidental or careless edit (a rename, a bad rebase) cannot silently change it — it is NOT a defense against a pull request that deliberately tries to bypass its own gates, since the `changes` job's YAML itself (including the invocation step) is read from the pull request's merge commit the same as everything else in this workflow; see #1022 for the honest framing and why that residual exposure is accepted.
